title: 13वीं मंज़िल का खौफनाक सच! लिफ्ट में ये गलती मत करना | रात के किस्से
description:
एक ऐसी इमारत जहाँ सिर्फ बारह मंज़िलें हैं, लेकिन लिफ्ट में तेरहवाँ बटन भी है। क्या आपने कभी सोचा है कि उस बटन को दबाने पर क्या होता है?

नेहा के साथ उस रात जो हुआ, वह आपके रोंगटे खड़े कर देगा। लिफ्ट बारहवीं मंजिल को पार कर ऊपर चली गई और दरवाजे के बाहर इंतजार कर रहा था वो शख्स, जो सालों पहले मर चुका था।

ऐसी ही डरावनी और रहस्यमयी कहानियों के लिए 'रात के किस्से' चैनल को अभी सब्सक्राइब करें!

#HorrorStories #HindiHorror #Bhootiyakahani #RaatKeKisse #ScaryShorts

characters.Neha: Indian woman, 26, ponytail, white office shirt, ID card lanyard, tired eyes

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: सुनिए... इस बिल्डिंग में बारह मंज़िलें हैं। फिर लिफ्ट में तेरहवाँ बटन क्यों है?
scenes.visual: Old Indian apartment lift panel, glowing button 13, flickering tube light, Indian woman, 26, ponytail, white office shirt, ID card lanyard, tired eyes
shots: A wide shot of an old Indian apartment building facade at night with a glowing entrance sign, flickering tube light overhead.
Close up of an old metal lift panel with weathered buttons inside an apartment building, flickering tube light casting shadows.
An Indian woman, 26, ponytail, white office shirt, ID card lanyard, tired eyes, looking at a mysterious glowing button 13.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: नेहा उस रात देर से लौटी। गार्ड ने बस एक बात कही, तेरहवाँ बटन कभी मत दबाना।
scenes.visual: Night security guard at old building gate warning a young woman, Indian woman, 26, ponytail, white office shirt, ID card lanyard, tired eyes
shots: An Indian woman, 26, ponytail, white office shirt, ID card lanyard, tired eyes, walking through heavy night shadows towards an apartment gate.
A night security guard sitting on a wooden chair at an old building gate, pointing his finger warningly.
An Indian woman, 26, ponytail, white office shirt, ID card lanyard, tired eyes, listening intently to the guard at night.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: लिफ्ट बंद हुई, और बटन अपने आप जल उठा। तेरह।
scenes.visual: Close-up finger away from panel, button 13 lighting by itself, Indian woman, 26, ponytail, white office shirt, ID card lanyard, tired eyes
shots: An Indian woman, 26, ponytail, white office shirt, ID card lanyard, tired eyes, standing inside a moving metal lift as doors close.
Close up of a lift control panel where the number 13 button lights up completely by itself in red.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: बारहवीं के बाद लिफ्ट रुकी नहीं। ऊपर जाती रही... जाती रही।
scenes.visual: Lift floor indicator jumping past 12, red light, Neha pressing buttons, Indian woman, 26, ponytail, white office shirt, ID card lanyard, tired eyes
shots: An old lift floor indicator rapidly blinking and jumping past the number twelve in red light.
An Indian woman, 26, ponytail, white office shirt, ID card lanyard, tired eyes, frantically pressing buttons inside a dark rising lift.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: दरवाज़ा खुला। सामने वही गलियारा था, पर हर दरवाज़े पर एक ही नंबर, तेरह।
scenes.visual: Long dim corridor, every door numbered 13, dust in air, Indian woman, 26, ponytail, white office shirt, ID card lanyard, tired eyes
shots: An old lift door sliding open to reveal a long, dark, dusty apartment corridor with eerie yellow lighting.
An Indian woman, 26, ponytail, white office shirt, ID card lanyard, tired eyes, stepping out into a corridor.
Close up of multiple old wooden apartment doors, every single door marked with the exact same number thirteen.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: और गलियारे के आख़िर में खड़ा था वही गार्ड... जिसकी आँखें बिल्कुल सफ़ेद थीं।
scenes.visual: Silhouette of guard at end of corridor with pale white eyes, Indian woman, 26, ponytail, white office shirt, ID card lanyard, tired eyes
shots: An Indian woman, 26, ponytail, white office shirt, ID card lanyard, tired eyes, looking down a long dim corridor.
A shadowy silhouette of a security guard standing motionless at the far end of a dark corridor.
Close up of the guard turning around, revealing completely pale white eyes staring blankly forward.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: नेहा ने बंद करने का बटन दबाया। दरवाज़ा बंद हुआ, लिफ्ट नीचे आई, गेट पर गार्ड सो रहा था।
scenes.visual: Ground floor gate, guard asleep on chair, Neha running out, Indian woman, 26, ponytail, white office shirt, ID card lanyard, tired eyes
shots: An Indian woman, 26, ponytail, white office shirt, ID card lanyard, tired eyes, frantically slamming her hand on the lift door close button.
An old metal lift rapidly descending inside a dark shaft, motion blur showing high speed.
Ground floor apartment gate where a night security guard is soundly sleeping on a wooden chair.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: अगली सुबह पता चला, वह गार्ड पंद्रह साल पहले उसी लिफ्ट में मरा था।
scenes.visual: Old newspaper clipping of a lift accident, yellowed paper, Indian woman, 26, ponytail, white office shirt, ID card lanyard, tired eyes
shots: An Indian woman, 26, ponytail, white office shirt, ID card lanyard, tired eyes, looking at a table in the morning light.
Close up of an old yellowed newspaper clipping on a wooden table detailing a tragic lift accident from years ago.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: आगे क्या हुआ? पूरी कहानी के लिए चैनल पर बने रहिए!

shots: A dark residential building exterior at night with only a single window glowing brightly on the top floor.
An Indian woman, 26, ponytail, white office shirt, ID card lanyard, tired eyes, standing anxiously in a dimly lit hallway.
